title: Our 3-5-2: Keep Shape, Win the Transition
format: 11v11 shape walk-through on a full pitch
kit: Blue bibs for us, red for the opposition
start: We start in our 3-5-2. Ball with the opposition midfielder.
intro_vo: Right lads. Our 3-5-2. Keep your shape, pack the middle, and win the first five seconds when the ball turns over.
parents: Blue is us in a 3-5-2. One sitting midfielder and two ahead make a triangle. Watch how we stay compact out of possession, open up in possession, and react in the first five seconds of a transition.
setup: Full pitch. Us in a 3-5-2 facing the right goal.
Midfield triangle: one CDM sitting, two CMs ahead.
Wing backs hold the width. Two strikers stay high.
Opposition start with the ball in midfield.
rules: Out of possession: pack the middle, force play wide, then press the channel and cut it off.
In possession: triangle stays connected, wing backs get wide, strikers pin the centre backs.
On every turnover: first five seconds decide it. Secure, support, spring.
restart: Reset to the shape after each phase.
points: CDM sits. Do not chase. You are the lid on the box.
Two CMs form the triangle with him. Stay connected.
Pack the middle so they have to go wide.
Press the channel, then cut the ball off when it moves.
Transition both ways in the first five seconds. That is the game.
progress: Add a condition: first goal after a turnover counts double.
Limit the CDM to three touches so the CMs have to rotate.

steps.say: Out of possession. Hold the shape. Back three connected, CDM sitting, triangle packed in the middle.
steps.vo: Out of possession. Hold your shape. Back three connected. CDM sitting. The two CMs make the triangle and we pack the middle.

steps.say: They have it central. We pack the middle so the channels are the only way on.
steps.vo: They have it central. Squeeze the middle. Force them wide. The channels are the only way on.

steps.say: Ball goes into the right channel. Nearest CM presses. CDM and the other CM cut off the next pass.
steps.vo: Ball into the right channel. Nearest CM, you press. CDM and the other CM, cut the next pass off. Do not dive in.

steps.say: They switch. The block slides across as one. Same shape, new side.
steps.vo: They switch it. Slide across together. Same shape, new side. Nobody leaves the triangle.

steps.say: In possession. Triangle opens. CDM receives, two CMs ahead, wing backs get wide, strikers pin.
steps.vo: We win it. In possession now. Triangle opens. CDM receives. Two CMs ahead. Wing backs, get wide. Strikers, pin their centre backs.

steps.say: Play through the triangle. First thought forward, second switch, third back to the CDM.
steps.vo: Play through the triangle. First thought forward. Second, switch. Third, back to the CDM. Keep the shape while you move it.

steps.say: Key bit. We lose it. First five seconds. Nearest two squeeze the ball. Everyone else gets goal side.
steps.vo: Key bit. We lose it. First five seconds. Nearest two, squeeze the ball. Everyone else, get goal side and rebuild the shape. That is the transition.

steps.say: We win it back. First five seconds the other way. Secure it, support beyond, spring forward.
steps.vo: We win it back. First five seconds the other way. Secure it under your foot. Nearest lad supports beyond. Then spring. That is why it has to be quick.

steps.say: Finish. Shape, triangle, first five seconds. That is our 3-5-2.
steps.vo: Finish. Keep the shape. Trust the triangle. Win the first five seconds. That is our 3-5-2. Well done lads.
